payload.core_mechanism_summary: After sorting, each element's contribution is computed as value*(2^i - 2^{n-1-i}) mod M, summing over all subsets' max-min.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts the coordinates, then iterates using power-of-two precomputation. No custom comparator, binary search, or sweep line; 'sorting_custom_key' is the best fit among limited options.
